Looking at the demo: the grid is divided into blocks by separator lines of color 3 (full rows/columns). Rare cells (non-base, non-separator colors) are replicated into every block at the same offset within the block.

Demo check: base=5, horizontal separator row 4, vertical separator col 2 → blocks start at rows [0,5], cols [0,3]. The 7 at (5,3) (offset 0,0 in block) copies to (0,0),(5,0),(0,3) — matches output. The 6 at (7,4) (offset 2,1) copies to (2,1),(7,1),(2,4) — matches.

For the test: base=2, separators rows 6,13 → row blocks start [0,7,14], single column block. Rare cells (5,6,7) in rows 14-19 get copied up into the other two blocks.

```python
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cnt = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    base = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep = None
    for c, v in cnt.items():
        if c == base:
            continue
        if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid) or \
           any(all(grid[r][j] == v for r in range(H)) for j in range(W)):
            sep = v
            break
    hlines = [r for r in range(H) if sep is not None and all(grid[r][j] == sep for j in range(W))]
    vlines = [j for j in range(W) if sep is not None and all(grid[r][j] == sep for r in range(H))]
    rstarts = [r for r in [0] + [r + 1 for r in hlines] if r < H]
    cstarts = [c for c in [0] + [c + 1 for c in vlines] if c < W]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(H):
        if r in hlines:
            continue
        for c in range(W):
            if c in vlines:
                continue
            v = grid[r][c]
            if v == base or v == sep:
                continue
            ri = max(i for i, s in enumerate(rstarts) if s <= r)
            ci = max(i for i, s in enumerate(cstarts) if s <= c)
            for s in rstarts:
                nr = s + (r - rstarts[ri])
                for t in cstarts:
                    nc = t + (c - cstarts[ci])
                    if nr < H and nc < W and nr not in hlines and nc not in vlines \
                       and out[nr][nc] == base:
                        out[nr][nc] = v
    return out
```
